北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，扬沙天气，体感 11℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖与补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, sandstorm and it feels like 11℃. Wear a mask, keep warm, and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 16℃，微风轻拂。享受这美好的天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 16℃ with a gentle breeze. Enjoy this lovely day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴空万里，体感 16℃，微风和煦。午后散步很舒服哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels like 16℃ with no wind. Perfect for an afternoon stroll!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，体感 23℃，湿度较高。注意防晒，保持清爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels like 23℃, high humidity. Mind the sun and stay fresh!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 20℃，湿度 67%。天气略潮，记得穿搭舒适哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 20℃, 67% humidity. A bit damp, dress comfortably!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感 15℃。适合出门踏青，感受春日美好！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 15℃. Great for an outing, enjoy the spring day!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 17℃，微风舒适。正是出游好时节呢！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 17℃, comfortable breeze. A perfect time to go out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感 20℃。温度适中，心情也会美美的！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels like 20℃. The temperature is just right, your mood will be great too!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴好，体感 20℃，湿度略高。外出穿搭要注意舒适哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and feels like 20℃, a bit humid. Dress comfortably when going out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 18℃，湿度只有 2%。记得多喝水，滋润一下！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 18℃, humidity only 2%. Drink more water to stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阳光正好，体感 21℃。舒适宜人，可以愉快出行哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and feels like 21℃. Pleasant, enjoy your outing!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感只有 1℃。请务必穿暖和，别冻着了！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels like only 1℃. Please dress warmly and don't catch a cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 4℃。虽然有阳光，还是要多加一件衣服哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels like 4℃. Despite the sun, remember to wear an extra layer!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 18℃，风力 4级。紫外线强，记得防晒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 18℃, wind force 4. Strong UV, remember sun protection!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 13℃，湿度 72%。体感偏凉，注意添衣防潮！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 13℃, 72% humidity. Feels cool, add clothes and mind the damp!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 6℃，湿度偏高。海风微凉，记得穿暖和！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like 6℃, high humidity. Sea breeze is cool, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 3℃，湿度偏高。体感较冷，务必多穿衣哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like 3℃, high humidity. Feels cold, be sure to wear more clothes!
